title: Sprint 7 launch + method naming
notes: Launched Sprint 7 as the new active producer-identity program after Sprint 6's pairwise merge-only path failed to produce a trustworthy execution route. Locked the new method family as identity_dossier_select_v1 (Identity Dossier Select): reusable producer dossiers, shortlist generation, select-best-or-none adjudication, explicit RELATED_BUT_DISTINCT handling, AI-only escalation, and merges only from accepted SAME_AS edges. Human pair review at scale is out; budget remains fixed; abstention is preferred over risky merges.

title: Identity dossier schema + candidate inventory
notes: Defined producer_dossier_v1, source_signal_inventory, and edge_taxonomy_v1 as the durable evidence contract for Sprint 7. Locked the cheap dossier as backbone-first and regulatory-aware because the canonical producer table is still sparse for websites, aliases, importer links, history, and producer-level external IDs. Fixed the selector label set at SAME_AS, RELATED_BUT_DISTINCT, NONE, and UNSURE; only accepted SAME_AS edges are merge-eligible. The next session should design shortlist generation against that fixed dossier object.

title: Autonomous continuation gating
notes: Added an explicit Autonomous continuation yes/no field to the session handoff protocol and tightened the Auto Next Session heartbeat to rely on that field instead of inferring readiness from prose. The current setting remains blocked because the shortlist seed-source decision for importer, retailer, and profile sources is still unresolved.

title: Shortlist generation design
notes: Defined shortlist_generation_v1 as the fixed retrieval contract for Identity Dossier Select. Locked Tier A-only candidate seeding (canonical lexical, LWIN producer names, TTB brand/applicant names, and state-registration brand/legal names), demoted importer/retailer/profile sources to rerank or escalation only, capped the raw candidate union at 24 and the final selector shortlist at 12, and added suppression rules for weak fuzzy hits, permit-only adjacency, shared-surname/first-word collisions, and merchant/importer-context-only candidates. The autonomy blocker from Session 10.2a is now cleared; the next session should design the selector harness against this fixed shortlist contract.

title: Selector harness design
notes: Defined selector_harness_v1 as the fixed select-best-or-none contract for Identity Dossier Select. Locked the model-visible packet to one anchor selector card plus up to 12 candidate mini-cards with explicit comparison blocks, required the selector to choose one candidate or none before applying SAME_AS / RELATED_BUT_DISTINCT / NONE / UNSURE, separated NONE from UNSURE by escalation worth, replaced long explanations with patterned reason codes plus evidence refs, and split the first proof into a selector-only frozen-packet pass plus a shortlist-integration smoke pass. The next session should design the AI-only escalation dossier and accepted-edge rules against that fixed selector contract.

title: Control layer design and proof prep
notes: Defined escalation_dossier_v1, accepted_edge_rules_v1, and selector_proof_v1 as the Sprint 7 control package for Identity Dossier Select. Locked escalation to UNSURE-only one-pass frontier cases, kept the heavy path on the same four-label contract, split durable graph state into accepted pairwise edges versus frontier records, clarified that selector-side NONE fans out only to candidates actually shown in the packet while empty shortlists write no pairwise negatives, and froze the next proof as a four-phase bundle: 48-case selector proof, 8-case escalation replay, shortlist smoke, and accepted-edge write simulation. The next session should build the local proof bundle, scorer, and write simulator without reopening policy or writing to the DB.

title: Bounded proof artifact build
notes: Built the frozen local selector_proof_v1 bundle and first execution scaffolding for Identity Dossier Select: hidden answer key, 48 Phase A selector packets, 8 Phase B escalation packets, Phase C shortlist manifest, normalized result schema, scorecard template, and Phase D accepted-edge/frontier write simulation, all under data/sprints/identity-er/proof/. Implemented the deterministic builder/scorer in pipeline/identity/selector_proof_v1.py, verified it against live read-only DB data, and confirmed the oracle self-check passes all four local phases with no packet-schema issues. The next session should run the first real bounded proof execution against the frozen packets, score the outputs, and write the Sprint 7 go/no-go memo.
